description: Corporate actions for a month. Return US corporate actions for a processing month, optionally filtered by SIP symbol. → Returns {total_count, range, last_update, data}. Select a processing month with month=YYYY-MM (2016-01 onward); optionally filter by a SIP: code from list_sip_symbols. Each row includes code, action_type, and the available dates and terms for that action.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

month.description: Processing month in YYYY-MM format, from 2016-01 onward.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

name: get_sip_corporate_actions
